title: Column under self-weight
sentence: A standing column loaded only by its own self-weight — `load.gravity` on a single fixed-base body.
theory: Self-weight gives a stress that grows linearly with depth, $\sigma(z) = \rho g (L - z)$, so the base carries $\rho g L$ regardless of the cross-section. `load.gravity` is a body force on every element, not a traction on a face, so it needs `rho` on the Material.
